PERSONALITY DEVELOPMENT-
DEALING WITH CUSTOMERS
21.1
APPROPRIATE BEHAVIOUR WITH CUSTOMERS
It is as important for a tailor to behave appropriately with the customers as it is to make
their garments skillfully. A tailor needs to be soft spoken andpleasant apart from being
skillfull. Without these qualities it will be difficult to have regular customers and expand
business. Hence, a tailor should keep the following points in mind.
1.
When a customer approaches, he/she should be greeted with apolite - Welcome,
how can I help you?
2.
Have the customer seated and ask whether he would like something to drink.
3.
If the customer shows a Cloth,examine it and ask what is to be made out of it or
ifhe asks for an estimate, give it.
4.
Measure the cloth after taking the measurements.
6.
While taking measurements, stand to one side and not in front of the c~tomer and
take measurements for the garment to be made.
7.
Take correct measurements after careful inspection ofthe figure of the customer.
8.
Note the name of the person, address, name of garment and the measurements
taken in the order look.
-

21.2
OBTAINING LOANS
Loans from banks and fmancial institutions
One needs money to start any business. Lack of money hampers business. Either one
must have own resources or one must know where to obtain money from - banks or
financial and centers or financial institutions.
1..
The govemnient offers the facility of obtaining loans for setting up small scale
industries. These loans can be obtained at a low rate from banks.
2.
The loan can be repayed in easy instalments.
3.
Apart from banks, many financial institutions also offer loans for establishing
industries.
4.
The differencebetween obtaininga loan from abank and from a financialinstitution
is that banks charge a much lower rate of interest.
S.
In order to obtain a loan one has to go to bank or financial institution, fill in an
application form and attach the project report ofthe proposed business.
6.
The bank considers the loan amount on the basis ofthe project report.
7.
Representatives of the bank will then inspect the proposed site of the business and
submit their report to the bank. The loan money will be sanctioned on the basis
of this report.
8.
Though a report has to be filed in both cases, it is faster to obtain a loan from a
financialinstitution.
-
In this way, loans can be obtained from banks and financial institutions.
